prompts.title: Active-Prompt
prompts.blurb: select uncertain examples, annotate them, and use them as task-specific demonstrations.
prompts.evidence: Moderate; primary research plus survey.
safety: Do not skip held-out eval after annotation.
Do not leak test cases into the demonstration pool.
Without an annotation budget and a regression set, active selection is not operational.
prompts.caveat: This is a data/annotation workflow, not a single magic prompt. Without an annotation budget and a regression set, active selection is not operational.
prompts.definition: select uncertain examples, annotate them, and use them as task-specific demonstrations.
prompts.avoid_when: there is no example pool, annotation process, or eval set.
prompts.model_api_controls:
Keep demonstration format aligned with the target model and output contract. Prefer structured
labels when demos are machine-scored. Measure uncertainty with independent samples or grader
disagreement, then lock the final exemplar set behind a held-out eval (evaluation best practices).
prompts.cost_latency: high upfront, lower during inference after examples are selected.
prompts.failure_modes:
mislabeled exemplars, selection bias, stale examples, skipping held-out eval after annotation,
leaking test cases into the demo pool.
